inlines.v: CAR, CAER, CHAR, in names of places, is sometimes the Celtic Caer, a town or city, as in Caermarthen. CAR, noun 1. A small vehicle moved on wheels, usually drawn by one horse. 2. In poetical language, any vehicle of dignity or splendor; a chariot of war, or of triumph. 3. The constellation called Charless wain or the bear.
